module origen_222985 (
    input [15:0] D,
    input [3:0] S,
    input VPWR,
    input VGND,
    input VPB,
    input VNB,
    output reg Z
);

reg [15:0] d_reg;
reg [3:0] s_reg;
reg vpwr_reg, vgnd_reg, vpb_reg, vnb_reg;

initial begin
    d_reg = 16'bX;
    s_reg = 4'bX;
    vpwr_reg = 1'bX;
    vgnd_reg = 1'bX;
    vpb_reg = 1'bX;
    vnb_reg = 1'bX;
end

always @(D, S, VPWR, VGND, VPB, VNB) begin
    if (VPWR == 1'bX && VGND == 1'bX && VPB == 1'bX && VNB == 1'bX) begin
        d_reg = 16'bX;
        s_reg = 4'bX;
        vpwr_reg = 1'bX;
        vgnd_reg = 1'bX;
        vpb_reg = 1'bX;
        vnb_reg = 1'bX;
    end

    if (VPWR == 1'b0 && VGND == 1'b0 && VPB == 1'b0 && VNB == 1'b0) begin
        d_reg = 16'b0;
        s_reg = 4'b0;
        vpwr_reg = 1'b0;
        vgnd_reg = 1'b0;
        vpb_reg = 1'b0;
        vnb_reg = 1'b0;
    end

    if (VPWR == 1'b1 && VGND == 1'b1 && VPB == 1'b1 && VNB == 1'b1) begin
        d_reg = 16'b1;
        s_reg = 4'b1;
        vpwr_reg = 1'b1;
        vgnd_reg = 1'b1;
        vpb_reg = 1'b1;
        vnb_reg = 1'b1;
    end

    if (VPWR == 1'bX) begin
        vpwr_reg = 1'bX;
    end

    if (VGND == 1'bX) begin
        vgnd_reg = 1'bX;
    end

    if (VPB == 1'bX) begin
        vpb_reg = 1'bX;
    end

    if (VNB == 1'bX) begin
        vnb_reg = 1'bX;
    end

    if (D == 16'bX) begin
        d_reg = 16'bX;
    end

    if (S == 4'bX) begin
        s_reg = 4'bX;
    end

    Z = d_reg[s_reg];
end
